description.zh: 页码，取值范围为大于0但不超过Integer最大值的整数。
description.en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. It cannot exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type.

The number of entries per page. Valid values:

- **30**

- **50**

- **100**

Default value: 30.

description.zh:
交换机所在地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~118703~~)查询交换机支持的所有地域ID。
description.en:
The ID of the region where the vSwitch resides.

> Call [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) to query the IDs of all regions that support vSwitches.
A list of vSwitches in the VPC.

description.zh:
VPC ID。

> 可通过接口[DescribeVpcs](~~35739~~)查看VPC信息详情。
description.en:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

> Call [DescribeVpcs](~~35739~~) to view the details of the VPC.
The ID of the zone where the vSwitch resides.
